[b][u]The Democratic Federal Republic of Bob and The Commonwealth Plans to Expand Global Reach[/u][/b]

As tensions in Elseyr and Erene as a whole escalate especially regarding our unfriendly neighbour the [nation]Technokratisches Kaiserreich[/nation] we have decided the best thing for us to do is once again expand the military beyond it's current strength and build the economy up significantly. We also intend to expand into mainland Elseyr to hopefully weaken the EDU's influence in the region. 

[b]Phase 1: Setup the Underprepared Preparedness Unit (UPU)[/b]

Anyone aged 18-40 will receive basic training on how to operate a firearm and hand-to-hand combat. A regulatory system will be in place for firearm training:

 All owners must have a clean criminal record

 The firearms are not allowed out of the bulletproof case for under any circumstances with the exception of imminent invasion from another nation or training exercises.

 Once aged over 30 you will lose the firearm to the government unless you join the military or you have special permission.

[b]If any of these are broken it will result in life in prison unless there is a change of circumstances.[/b]

[b]Phase 2: It's probably nothing but just in case...[/b]

Advertisement campaigns supporting the military will appear more frequently in the hopes to reach another 100,000 troops to work in the military both with a gun or in supporting jobs.
 
Military spending will also increase from £200 billion to £275 billion. During this period we also aim to hit £3.5 Trillion in GDP. 

[b]Phase 2.5: Koondzsulee [/b]

The £500 Billion megaproject "Koondzsulee" has finished construction. If you do not know what Koondzsulee is it is the newest State within the country built out of artificial islands. It has on main island on which the city of Koonzsuopolis will be built. Koonzsuopolis will have capacity for over 30 million people. I will have state of the set infrastructure with everything from drone delivery to Mag-Lev Trains. It is a car free city on the surface and deeper down is a ginormous area full of road-tunnels this is where all lorries (trucks), Taxis, Buses, and Coaches will travel. It will also have many cars allowing access in and out of the city. Around the city is a large forested area to help reduce the overall carbon footprint of the city.

In surrounding islands we have the Suburb areas which will be home to over 1 million people. It also includes 4 military islands to protect the megalopolis.

[b]Phase 3: Tanks very much[/b]

Challenger 3 tanks will begin mass production aiming to build 300 of them. Mass production of other weapons, artillery, transport lorries and armoured vehicles will also begin. 

The biggest update will be the construction of 5 more destroyers, Submarines and Frigates along with 75 more coastal patrol vessels. This along with the construction of 50 more Eurofighter Typhoons along with the development of a next gen fighter jet to be named the "Black Poison I". 

[b] Phase 4: Expansion Request [/b]

The BR Bob wishes to expand into the unoccupied area of land that borders the Bobian Elseyr Exclave (B.E.E.). Roughly 10,000 pixels please GDP increase like 150 billion population increase none?

General Fereydun has proposed a new constitution for a plebiscite. The new constitution, if approved, will:

[List]
[*]Elect General Fereydun as President of Dhornaper for a term of ten years.
[*]Divide the legislative into three houses, the Senate, the Council, and the House of Representatives.
[*]Abolish the Criminal Courts and make all criminal trials held in the First Courts instead with an optional jury for crimes that would have previously qualified for the Criminal Courts.
[/list]

The new constitution has other reforms as well but guarantees the rights a liberties of Citizens as existed in the previous constitution.[/quote]

[b][i][u]Dhornaper News Network[/u][/i][/b]

The result of the plebiscite has been concluded. The results are:

10,110,070 votes in favor
50,562 votes against

The new constitution has passed.
